text:
I had a great experience at VR Health Medical Lab Center! They offer a wide variety of health check-up packages at very reasonable prices — seriously great value for the money. The clinic is conveniently located, and they provide free parking, which is a huge plus.

Today, I initially planned to check my kidney function and thyroid hormone levels. Separately, these tests cost 490 THB and 690 THB, totaling 1,180 THB. But I asked the medical technologist whether I could substitute the thyroid test into the 2,550 THB health check-up package, which originally includes urine test, stool test, and screening for colon and stomach cancer. They said yes! They customized the package for me right away — so helpful and flexible.

For just 2,550 THB, I got so many tests done — totally worth it. The restroom was also clean and well-prepared, so collecting urine and stool samples was simple and hygienic. Best of all, I didn’t need an appointment. Just walked in and got everything done right away.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for an annual health check-up. The staff were incredibly supportive before, during, and after the examination. They explained everything in detail, and I even got my blood sugar results instantly. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Dr. Niwech
